WITH hand_tally AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing') AS throws_hand,
    COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS tally
  FROM manager_award ma
  INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing')
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(tally) AS total_count FROM hand_tally
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws_hand,
    tally,
    tally / t.total_count AS share
  FROM hand_tally, total t
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(tally) AS combined_tally,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share - a.avg_share) AS above_avg
FROM with_shares ws, avg_share_calc a
WHERE ws.share > a.avg_share
